---
title: Burn a feed cell
description: Remove a feed cell you no longer need and get its CKB back.
---

```ts
const tx = await oracle.burnFeedCell(typeScript);
const fee = await oracle.completeFee(tx, signer);
if (fee.status === "ok") await signer.sendTransaction(fee.tx);
```

The type script always allows a burn; the cell's lock decides who may. The capacity (about 280 CKB)
goes back to you as change. Burned cells can never be recreated with the same identity, so update
any contract that pinned it.
